statement: AMD claims its Helios rack, combining 72 Instinct MI455X GPUs and 18 6th Gen EPYC CPUs, delivers up to 30% more inference tokens per dollar than the competition, and that MI455X delivers 34x higher token throughput than MI355X.
why: If inference cost per token falls at the rack level, buyers can serve more tokens for the same spend, which improves the economics of deploying accelerators; the claims are vendor marketing with no workload, precision or configuration detail captured.

impact.mechanism: Better tokens per dollar at rack scale lowers the cost of serving inference, expanding the volume of workloads that clear an economic threshold.

evidence.excerpt: up to 30% more inference tokens per dollar than the competition

confidence.basis: Unqualified vendor performance marketing claim carried by a newswire, with the competitor unnamed and no workload or configuration detail; no independent benchmark in the document.
